0.name: The Fool
0.upright: A fresh start is asking for your yes. Pack light, stay curious, and take the first step even if the path ahead is still foggy.
0.reversed: Pause before you leap. You may be holding back from a start you are ready for, or rushing into one you have not thought through.
0.love: New romance or a playful reset — stay open, not naive.
0.career: A new role or venture favors the bold beginner.
0.money: Small brave bets beat big blind ones.
0.health: Move your body; watch for careless knocks.

1.name: The Magician
1.upright: You already have every tool this needs. Pick one goal, focus your skill on it, and act — this is a week for doing, not doubting.
1.reversed: Your talent is leaking into too many directions, or someone is selling confidence they do not have. Narrow down and verify.
1.love: Charm is high — use it honestly, not to impress.
1.career: A skill you underrate is exactly what the task needs.
1.money: Negotiate; you have more leverage than you think.
1.health: Channel restless energy into one healthy routine.

2.name: The High Priestess
2.upright: The answer is already in you. Get quiet, notice what you keep circling back to, and trust the pull before you can explain it.
2.reversed: You are overriding your own knowing — with other people's opinions, or with busyness. Secrets (kept or kept from you) need daylight.
2.love: Pay attention to what is unsaid between you.
2.career: Wait one beat before committing; information is still surfacing.
2.money: Read the fine print; something is unstated.
2.health: Your body is signaling — sleep, rest, listen.

3.name: The Empress
3.upright: Tend what you want to grow — a project, a relationship, yourself. Comfort, beauty, and patience compound into abundance.
3.reversed: You are pouring out with nothing coming back in, or gripping too tightly. Refill your own cup first; loosen the grip.
3.love: Warmth and care deepen the bond; let yourself receive too.
3.career: Mentor, create, make things beautiful — it pays.
3.money: Steady nurturing grows savings; avoid comfort overspending.
3.health: Rest, good food, nature — indulge the senses kindly.

4.name: The Emperor
4.upright: Build the frame and the picture will hold. Set clear rules, budgets, and boundaries — order now buys freedom later.
4.reversed: Too rigid or too loose: either control is choking the life out, or nothing is holding. Adjust the structure, not the goal.
4.love: Commitment needs clear agreements, not assumptions.
4.career: Process, hierarchy, and follow-through win the day.
4.money: Budget like an emperor: every baht has a post.

5.name: The Hierophant
5.upright: Tried paths and wise guides have something for you. Learn the tradition first — then decide what to keep and what to reshape.
5.reversed: Rules for rules' sake are in the way. Question the doctrine, the guru, the 'we have always done it this way'.
5.love: Shared values and rituals hold you together.
5.career: A mentor, course, or institution opens the next door.
5.money: Conventional advice fits now; skip exotic schemes.
5.health: Trust established care; get a second opinion if uneasy.

6.name: The Lovers
6.upright: A union — of people or of values — is the heart of this. Choose what you truly align with, and let the choice be wholehearted.
6.reversed: Something is off-key: values clashing, a third pull, or a decision postponed. Name the misalignment before it names you.
6.love: Deep bond, real choice. Choose each other daily.
6.career: Partnership and shared vision beat solo grinding.
6.money: Align spending with what you actually value.
6.health: Balance caring for others with caring for yourself.

7.name: The Chariot
7.upright: Grip the reins and move. Opposing pulls resolve when you commit to one direction — victory comes through focused will.
7.reversed: You are revving with no steering, or pushing a wall. Re-aim, drop a competing goal, then drive again.
7.love: Steer the relationship somewhere on purpose; drift kills it.
7.career: Ambitious push now — keep every horse facing one way.
7.money: Drive toward one money goal; stop splitting fuel.
7.health: Directed effort (training plan, sleep hours) works.

8.name: Strength
8.upright: Real strength is gentle: patience with yourself, courage without noise. Tame the lion with calm persistence, not the whip.
8.reversed: You are muscling through on fumes, or doubting a strength you actually have. Soften the grip; rest is part of power.
8.love: Patience and softness tame tensions; no ultimatums.
8.health: Gentle consistency heals more than heroic bursts.

9.name: The Hermit
9.upright: Step back and go inward for a while. Fewer voices, one lantern: your own experience will show the next step.
9.reversed: Solitude has curdled into isolation, or you are dodging the quiet work. Reconnect — with one person, or with yourself.
9.love: A little space clarifies; too much starves. Say what you need.
9.career: Deep work beats meetings this week; document as you go.
9.money: Review alone before any joint decision.
9.health: Restorative solitude: sleep, walks, less screen.

10.name: Wheel of Fortune
10.upright: The wheel is turning in your favor. Ride the upswing: say yes to the opening, and remember luck favors the ready.
10.reversed: Timing is off or change feels forced. Do not fight the cycle — stabilize what you can and wait for the turn.
10.love: A turning point: ride it together, not against each other.
10.career: Fortune shifts — position yourself where it lands.
10.money: Upswing favors action; downswing favors saving.
10.health: Cycles pass; support the body through the low part.

11.name: Justice
11.upright: Weigh it honestly and call it fairly. Truth, contracts, and consequences are in focus — act so your side stays clean.
11.reversed: Something is tilted: bias (yours or theirs), blame-shifting, or a bill coming due. Rebalance before it compounds.
11.career: Contracts, reviews, credit where due — document everything.
11.money: Debts, taxes, fairness in splits: settle cleanly.
11.health: Honest accounting of habits; adjust without shame.

12.name: The Hanged Man
12.upright: Hang loose on purpose. Flip the viewpoint — the answer looks different upside down — and let timing do its half.
12.reversed: The pause has expired into a stall, or you are suffering for show. Either move or admit you are choosing to wait.
12.love: Stop pushing; see it from their angle for a week.
12.career: Delay is data. Use the waiting productively.
12.money: Hold position; no heroics in fog.
12.health: Rest is the treatment; stop negotiating with it.

13.name: Death
13.upright: Something is over so something can begin. Grieve it, thank it, lay it down — the transformation needs the empty hands.
13.reversed: You are dragging what already ended. The longer the grip, the heavier the cost; release is overdue, not optional.
13.love: An old pattern must die for love to live.
13.career: End the dead project; free the energy.
13.money: Cut the losing line; mourn the sunk cost once.
13.health: Release one habit that belongs to an older you.

14.name: Temperance
14.upright: Mix, don't swing. Small steady blends — work and rest, give and take — turn ordinary days into quiet gold.
14.reversed: Too much of something (or someone) has tipped the scales. Cut back to the middle path; extremes are billing you.
14.love: Blend, don't merge. Keep your own flavor.
14.career: Sustainable pace; mix deep work with recovery.
14.money: Middle path: save some, enjoy some.

15.name: The Devil
15.upright: Look honestly at the chain: the habit, the story, the comfort you chose. Naming it loosens it — shame tightens it.
15.reversed: The chains are loosening. Keep walking out: one honest day at a time, and do not romanticize the cage.
15.love: Obsession or control dressed as passion — call it out.
15.career: Golden handcuffs? Price your freedom honestly.
15.money: Spending loops and shiny traps — freeze one card.
15.health: Face the coping habit; replace, don't just remove.

16.name: The Tower
16.upright: What was shaky is falling — let it. Towers fall so truer ones rise; save what matters, release the rest to the lightning.
16.reversed: You are holding up what already cracked, or rebuilding quietly after the bang. Either way: smaller, truer, on rock this time.
16.love: A shock clears the air — rebuild honest or release.
16.career: Structures change; be the one who adapts first.
16.money: Expect the jolt; keep a buffer for falling bricks.
16.health: Sudden signals need attention now, not later.

17.name: The Star
17.upright: After the storm, stars. Hope is realistic now: heal gently, wish concretely, and let small steady lights guide you.
17.reversed: Hope feels far, but it is dimmed, not dead. Tend one small light — a routine, a person, a page — until it steadies.
17.career: Share your vision; hope attracts help.
17.money: Calm recovery; wish with a plan attached.
17.health: Healing is underway; support it gently.

18.name: The Moon
18.upright: Things glimmer but do not resolve yet. Trust dreams and hunches, double-check facts, and do not sign in moonlight.
18.reversed: Fog is lifting: fears named shrink, confusion untangles. Keep going — daylight is a decision away.
18.love: Illusions dissolve; see the person, not the projection.
18.career: Verify before you commit; rumors are loud now.
18.health: Sleep and dreams carry messages; rest more.

19.name: The Sun
19.upright: Yes — bright, simple yes. Joy, clarity, and energy are yours: celebrate openly and share the warmth around.
19.reversed: Clouds, not night: joy delayed or dimmed, success still coming. Do not fake the smile — tend the small good things.
19.love: Warm, honest, playful — let it show.
19.career: Visibility and wins; take the bow.
19.money: Sunny outlook; still budget the picnic.

20.name: Judgement
20.upright: A calling is sounding — rise to the bigger version of you. Forgive the old chapters; answer with changed action.
20.reversed: The inner judge is too loud, or you keep missing the call. Turn criticism into instruction; tie up one old thread.
20.love: Forgive and choose fresh — or admit it is over.
20.career: Your calling is knocking; answer with a move.
20.money: Review past money lessons; apply one now.
20.health: Forgive the body; start the new regimen kindly.

21.name: The World
21.upright: The circle closes beautifully. Complete it, celebrate it, carry the lesson — a bigger circle is already forming.
21.reversed: Nearly there: one loose end keeps the circle open. Tie it, and the completion (and the celebration) unlocks.
21.love: Wholeness together — or whole on your own. Both count.
21.career: Finish strong; the credential is the completion.
21.money: A cycle completes; harvest, then plan the next.
21.health: Integration: body, mind, and rhythm aligned.

22.name: Ace of Wands
22.upright: A spark lands: an idea, an invitation, a surge of wanting that feels alive. Say yes to the first small step while the fire is warm.
22.reversed: The spark struggles to catch: delays, mixed signals, or energy spent in the wrong direction. Wait for real heat rather than forcing smoke.
22.love: Attraction with momentum; let it be playful before it is serious.
22.career: Pitch it, start it, volunteer; raw initiative beats polish today.
22.money: A bright idea is not a budget; seed it small and watch it.
22.health: Energy returns when you move; start gently, then build.

23.name: Two of Wands
23.upright: You hold the world loosely and look outward: two real paths, both viable. Plan past the horizon, then commit your weight to one.
23.reversed: The map stays folded: indecision, fear of the bigger life, or planning as a hiding place. Choose the path you can grow on.
23.love: Deciding what you actually want precedes asking for it.
23.career: Strategy day: compare the two roads with numbers, not moods.
23.money: Long-view planning pays; avoid scattering small bets.
23.health: A plan you can repeat beats a heroic one-day effort.

24.name: Three of Wands
24.upright: What you launched is moving: early results, wider horizons, help from afar. Keep your eyes on the harbour and your hand steady.
24.reversed: Ships delayed and tempers short. Check what is actually blocked before blaming the wind; some of it is small thinking.
24.love: Growth together, or love at a distance handled with patience.
24.career: Expansion works; prepare the next stage before it lands.
24.money: Returns are en route; do not spend the cargo before docking.
24.health: Steady progress; widen the routine rather than intensifying it.

25.name: Four of Wands
25.upright: A milestone worth marking: people gather, the roof holds, joy is communal. Celebrate properly; harmony is also an achievement.
25.reversed: The party feels off: restlessness at home or celebration postponed. Fix the small friction instead of faking the toast.
25.love: Public joy as a couple, or welcoming someone into your circle.
25.career: Team milestones count; thank people out loud.
25.money: Spend on shared joy within limits; home costs stay planned.
25.health: Rest inside community; celebration is recovery too.

26.name: Five of Wands
26.upright: Sparks fly where ambitions collide: sparring, rivalry, everyone talking at once. Treat it as training, not war; the best idea can win.
26.reversed: The fight drains or dissolves: conflict avoided too long, or tension finally spent. Name the real disagreement while it is small.
26.love: Sparring can be chemistry or combat; keep it kind and it stays play.
26.career: Compete on merit; do not make rivals of teammates.
26.money: Too many hands on one pot; agree the split before spending.
26.health: Burn the static off with movement, not arguments.

27.name: Six of Wands
27.upright: The crowd sees it: a win, praise, the ride through town. Accept recognition graciously; it fuels the next campaign.
27.reversed: Applause delayed or pride bruised: a win that feels hollow, or credit going elsewhere. Let results argue for you.
27.love: Being chosen and shown off a little; enjoy being proud together.
27.career: Visibility is high; document the win, share credit.
27.money: A bonus or lift is possible; do not inflate lifestyle overnight.
27.health: Confidence helps the body; avoid victory laps that injure.

28.name: Seven of Wands
28.upright: You hold the hill: others want the spot, the budget, the say. Stand for what you built; conviction is a resource, spend it well.
28.reversed: Too many challengers, or the crouch becomes the position. Pick which ground is truly yours and let the rest go.
28.love: Defend the relationship's boundaries, not your ego.
28.career: Justify your call with calm facts; do not fight every critic.
28.money: Guard the core budget; say no to raids dressed as favours.
28.health: Sustainable effort beats heroic defence; rest is strategy.

29.name: Eight of Wands
29.upright: Everything moves at once: messages, decisions, travel, momentum. Aim before the volley lands and ride the clear air.
29.reversed: Arrows scatter: delays, crossed wires, haste making waste. Slow the send button; one clear message beats eight fast ones.
29.love: Fast developments; enjoy the rush, confirm the meaning.
29.career: Green lights across the board; prioritise before pouncing.
29.money: Quick moves possible; read the small print at speed, twice.
29.health: Momentum is medicine; protect sleep while life accelerates.

30.name: Nine of Wands
30.upright: Bandaged but standing: you are closer than you feel. One more honest push, with your guard up and your lesson learned.
30.reversed: The guard never lowers: exhaustion posing as vigilance. Rest is not surrender; let someone trusted hold the wall.
30.love: Old wounds set the watch; let present kindness update the guard.
30.career: Finish the campaign; document so the next push is lighter.
30.money: Protect reserves; this is not the week for lending strength away.
30.health: Recovery is the training now; sleep like it matters, it does.

31.name: Ten of Wands
31.upright: The bundle is heavy because you picked up every stick. The work matters; the carrying style does not. Put some down before the last steps.
31.reversed: Release begins: delegating, dropping, saying the overdue no. Let the pile shrink to what is actually yours.
31.love: Care shown as labour still needs words; share the load early.
31.career: Delegate or renegotiate scope before burnout negotiates for you.
31.money: Cut one recurring weight; effort is also a currency.
31.health: The back keeps the score; lighten before it invoices you.

32.name: Page of Wands
32.upright: A bright messenger: news that excites, a new interest, beginner's fire. Explore loudly, commit later.
32.reversed: Static on the line: hasty words, false alarms, enthusiasm without aim. Verify before you volley the news onward.
32.love: Flirtation and spark; keep it light until it proves depth.
32.career: Volunteer for the interesting task; curiosity is visible.
32.money: Small exciting bets only; novelty is not due diligence.
32.health: Try the new class, route, or recipe; play counts as training.

33.name: Knight of Wands
33.upright: The charger arrives: adventure, travel, a bold move made at speed. Ride it where it counts; aim the horse before the gallop.
33.reversed: Hot hooves, cold hearth: reckless starts, restless exits, snags on the road. Slow down enough to actually arrive.
33.love: Whirlwind energy; thrilling, and needs one honest conversation.
33.career: Pitch boldly, chase the opening; follow-through sells it.
33.money: Fast money tempts; speed is not a strategy.
33.health: Channel the charge into sport before it becomes friction.

34.name: Queen of Wands
34.upright: Warm authority: confidence that rooms can feel, creativity with a spine. Lead by lighting other candles, not dimming them.
34.reversed: The fire turns inward: jealousy, insecurity, or warmth with conditions. Refill your own cup before directing the room.
34.love: Magnetic and generous; ask for admiration honestly, not by test.
34.career: Visible leadership lands; mentor someone visibly too.
34.money: Invest in presentation and people; both compound.
34.health: Vitality loves rhythm: sun, movement, colour, company.

35.name: King of Wands
35.upright: The long view with fire behind it: vision people can follow, risks taken on purpose. Lead the campaign, not every skirmish.
35.reversed: Vision curdles into overreach: impulsive calls, a court that only cheers. Invite one honest dissent before deciding.
35.love: Generous leadership at home; make room for another throne.
35.career: Set the direction publicly; hire or delegate the how.
35.money: Big-picture bets need boring safeguards; pair them.
35.health: Sustainable pace is the real flex; protect the engine.

36.name: Ace of Cups
36.upright: The cup fills from inside: new love, friendship, faith, or simply feeling again. Let it overflow toward someone.
36.reversed: The cup is covered: feelings blocked, numb, or poured where they are not met. Name the feeling before filling anything.
36.love: A genuine opening; say the soft thing first.
36.career: Work with heart in it appears; follow meaning, then money.
36.money: Generosity flows; give from surplus, not from guilt.
36.health: Emotional rest is physical rest; cry, laugh, hydrate.

37.name: Two of Cups
37.upright: Two cups, raised level: partnership with mutual respect, a bond that pours both ways. Meet them halfway, exactly halfway.
37.reversed: One cup pours, the other watches: imbalance, a truce cooling, or a bond needing repair. Check the levels honestly.
37.love: The real thing has reciprocity; look for effort that matches yours.
37.career: A 1:1 alliance strengthens; put the understanding in writing.
37.money: Shared finances need shared rules; agree them kindly.
37.health: Heal in company; ask for the specific help you need.

38.name: Three of Cups
38.upright: Raise it with your people: friendship, reunion, shared joy multiplied. Community is the blessing here, not background.
38.reversed: The toast sours slightly: gossip, a third wheel, or one toast too many. Keep the circle kind and the cup moderate.
38.love: Love inside a happy circle; friends are part of the romance.
38.career: Celebrate the team win; networks quietly open doors.
38.money: Group spending is joyful and slippery; set the kitty rules.
38.health: Joy is contagious medicine; schedule your people.

39.name: Four of Cups
39.upright: Arms crossed under the tree: boredom, apathy, an offer unnoticed at your elbow. Look up before concluding life is flat.
39.reversed: The fog lifts: interest returns, the offered cup finally seen. Say yes to one small thing and watch appetite follow.
39.love: Emotional flatness is information, not verdict; say what is missing.
39.career: A dull patch hides an opening; review the unnoticed offer.
39.money: Avoid apathy spending; check the account you have been ignoring.
39.health: Low mood is a signal; light, air, and one person help.

40.name: Five of Cups
40.upright: Three cups down, and grief is honest work. Two still stand behind you: grieve what spilled, then turn around; the bridge is there.
40.reversed: The turn begins: regret loosening, help accepted, the walk back over the bridge. Let the past be a place you visited.
40.love: Sorrow needs witnessing, not fixing; stay or be stayed with.
40.career: A setback is not the whole portfolio; salvage what stands.
40.money: Count what remains before mourning what left; rebuild from the two cups.
40.health: Grief lives in the body; gentle routines carry it.

41.name: Six of Cups
41.upright: Sweet water from an old well: nostalgia, old friends, places that knew you young. Visit warmly; bring something back.
41.reversed: The past will not move out: rose-tinted traps or an old story driving. Thank it, then return to the present tense.
41.love: An old flame or an old softness in a current love; check which.
41.career: Past skills and contacts resurface usefully; call them.
41.money: Old debts or gifts resurface; settle them cleanly.
41.health: Comfort rituals from childhood still work; use them kindly.

42.name: Seven of Cups
42.upright: Seven cups shimmer with dragons and jewels alike: many options, not all real. Choose by the life you want, not the sparkle.
42.reversed: The mist thins: one wish proves true, the rest were weather. Commit to the real cup and let fantasies retire.
42.love: Projecting is easy now; ask who they are, not who they gleam as.
42.career: Too many shiny paths; score them against one clear goal.
42.money: Avoid glittering schemes; boring and real wins.
42.health: Decision fatigue is real; fewer choices, deeper rest.

43.name: Eight of Cups
43.upright: Eight cups stacked neatly, and still you walk: leaving the almost-right for the true thing. The moonlit road is the honest one.
43.reversed: Half out the door: fear of change or drifting back to the familiar cups. Decide what would make staying different, or go kindly.
43.love: Leaving what almost worked takes more love, not less.
43.career: A role that no longer feeds you; plan the exit with grace.
43.money: Walk from sunk costs; the moon is not an expense line.
43.health: Restlessness is data; the body wants a truer routine.

44.name: Nine of Cups
44.upright: The wish card: contentment you can taste, pride in what fills your table. Ask clearly; gratitude seasons it.
44.reversed: Full cup, flat taste: getting it did not feed you, or wanting crowds out having. Revisit what the wish was for.
44.love: Emotional generosity attracts; enjoy being delighted in.
44.career: A goal lands; savour before sprinting to the next.
44.money: Comfort is real now; keep one wish funded, not five.
44.health: Pleasure is part of health; schedule it without apology.

45.name: Ten of Cups
45.upright: Rainbow over the house: lasting joy, chosen family, love that includes the ordinary days. Build the home scenes you keep picturing.
45.reversed: Weather inside the house: values clashing or harmony performed for show. Real repair starts with one honest table conversation.
45.love: The long-game card: tend the daily, not just the milestone.
45.career: Success that includes home life is the brief; protect both.
45.money: Household alignment on money creates the actual wealth.
45.health: Belonging is a health metric; invest in your people.

46.name: Page of Cups
46.upright: A tender message surfaces: an apology, an idea, a feeling with a fish in it. Stay curious; sensitivity is the instrument.
46.reversed: Static on the heart line: moody news, feelings performed or blocked. Wait for the sincere version before reacting.
46.love: Sweet, shy openings; gentleness lands better than grand gestures.
46.career: Creative hunches deserve one small test, not a launch.
46.money: Do not lend on a feeling; check the facts with love.
46.health: Name the feeling in one sentence; the body relaxes.

47.name: Knight of Cups
47.upright: The romantic rider: an offer, invitation, or quest of the heart, delivered gracefully. Let feeling propose; let sense sign.
47.reversed: The tide brings foam: moody offers, grand words, weather instead of climate. Judge by follow-through, not poetry.
47.love: Someone leads with their heart; meet sincerity with sincerity.
47.career: Pitch with story and grace; charm opens, craft closes.
47.money: Beware beautiful pitches; romance is not due diligence.
47.health: Moods move like weather; routines are the climate you control.

48.name: Queen of Cups
48.upright: The sea-queen: compassion with depth perception, intuition you can steer by. Listen below the words; counsel gently.
48.reversed: The tide comes inside: overwhelm, codependence, boundaries dissolved. Your feelings are data, not duties.
48.love: Deep attunement is your gift; do not disappear into their weather.
48.career: Emotional intelligence is the strategy; use it openly.
48.money: Generosity with boundaries keeps the well full.
48.health: Solitude refills what empathy spends; book it.

49.name: King of Cups
49.upright: The calm king: feelings mastered, not muted; diplomacy with a pulse. Steer the room by steadiness, not volume.
49.reversed: The lid sits tight: feelings suppressed or used as leverage. Thaw one honest conversation before deciding anything big.
49.love: Steady devotion wins; say the warm thing out loud too.
49.career: Negotiate from calm; your steadiness is the offer.
49.money: Unemotional money decisions, reviewed on schedule.
49.health: What is swallowed sits somewhere; give it words and water.

50.name: Ace of Swords
50.upright: One clean cut: clarity, a truth named, a mind made up. Use the sword for surgery, not war; the first honest sentence changes everything.
50.reversed: The blade is fogged: confusion, mixed facts, or a truth landing badly. Gather real information before swinging.
50.love: One honest conversation clears months of weather.
50.career: Decide, document, communicate once and clearly.
50.money: Read the contract; the truth is in clause three.
50.health: Name the worry precisely; vague dread shrinks when written.

51.name: Two of Swords
51.upright: Blindfold on, blades crossed: a truce that is really a postponed choice. Peace kept by not-looking has an expiry date; choose your timing, then look.
51.reversed: The blindfold slips: too much information, or the choice finally made. Breathe; deciding badly beats starving between doors.
51.love: An unspoken thing guards the peace; it costs more each week.
51.career: Two options, one deadline; use criteria, not comfort.
51.money: Avoiding the statement is still a decision; open it.
51.health: Mental rest needs the loop closed; decide or schedule the deciding.

52.name: Three of Swords
52.upright: The heart-piercing card: sorrow, betrayal, or a truth that hurts to hear. Rain is part of it; grief is not a malfunction, and it does move through.
52.reversed: The swords come out one by one: healing, forgiveness offered or accepted, pain leaving the body. Let the scar be a seam, not a vault.
52.love: Heartbreak needs honesty and time; do not rush the stitching.
52.career: Painful feedback may be accurate; extract the useful third.
52.money: A loss hurts; count it once, learn it once, stop re-paying it.
52.health: Grief and stress are physical; rest like it is treatment.

53.name: Four of Swords
53.upright: The knight lies down on purpose: rest, recovery, a mind stood down. Retreat is the strategy; the sword hangs within reach, not in hand.
53.reversed: Rest refused or interrupted: the mind keeps fencing in bed. Protect the recovery window like an appointment with yourself.
53.love: Quiet togetherness heals more than processing everything tonight.
53.career: Strategic pause before the next campaign; sharpen offline.
53.money: No big decisions from exhaustion; sleep on every signature.
53.health: Actual rest: horizontal, unhurried, screens elsewhere.

54.name: Five of Swords
54.upright: Won, and the field looks like that: a victory whose price was people. Pick up only the swords that are yours; some wins to decline next time.
54.reversed: Smoke after the fight: resentment lingering, or a genuine attempt to reconcile. Bury the weapons you keep tripping over.
54.love: Being right at that volume costs the relationship; choose the us.
54.career: Win the point, keep the room; you will need these people.
54.money: Do not win a refund and lose a relationship worth more.
54.health: Conflict hormones are expensive; discharge them kindly.

55.name: Six of Swords
55.upright: A quiet boat to calmer water: transition, recovery, leaving turbulence without a scene. Healing is often just steady rowing.
55.reversed: The boat circles: unfinished business, baggage riding along, or resisting the crossing you chose. Name what is still aboard.
55.love: Moving on together, or apart, with dignity intact.
55.career: A gradual move beats a dramatic quit; row, do not leap.
55.money: Slow improvement is real improvement; keep the route boring.
55.health: Recovery is a crossing, not a switch; pace the oars.

56.name: Seven of Swords
56.upright: The quiet exit with armfuls of swords: strategy, discretion, solving it your own way. Clever is fine; keep it honest with yourself about why solo.
56.reversed: The plan surfaces: conscience, exposure, or a shortcut repriced. Coming clean early is cheaper than being found out.
56.love: Something unsaid is tiptoeing; bring it into the room kindly.
56.career: Work the angle, document your part; lone-wolf has limits.
56.money: Check the quiet leak; small print and small print only.
56.health: Avoiding the check-up is also a strategy; pick a better one.

57.name: Eight of Swords
57.upright: Bound and blindfolded among swords that are not even planted deep: restriction that feels total and is mostly perspective. One small step proves the ropes are loose.
57.reversed: The blindfold comes off by your own hand: liberation, a door noticed, help accepted. Walk; the swords stay behind.
57.love: Feeling trapped deserves a witness; say it before it hardens.
57.career: The constraint is real but partial; find the unguarded degree of freedom.
57.money: Feeling stuck is not a spreadsheet; list actual options.
57.health: Small agency is medicine; one doable change today.

58.name: Nine of Swords
58.upright: 3 a.m. with every worst case queued: anxiety, guilt, the loop that feels like fact. It is a feeling with good stamina, not a prophecy; morning edits it.
58.reversed: The night loosens: worry named, help accepted, dawn doing its work. Tell one person the actual fear; it shrinks in daylight.
58.love: Do not sentence the relationship at 3 a.m.; revisit at breakfast.
58.career: Write the worst case and its plan; the loop hates paper.
58.money: Night arithmetic lies; check balances in daylight only.
58.health: Sleep hygiene is the treatment plan; screens down, worry journal out.

59.name: Ten of Swords
59.upright: Face down at the bottom, and the sky is already lightening: a painful ending that is, mercifully, an ending. What is finished cannot keep happening to you; rise slowly.
59.reversed: Getting up with swords still being removed: survival mode, recovery in progress. You do not have to be inspiring yet; standing is enough.
59.love: An ending can be mercy; let it end all the way.
59.career: The collapsed thing frees your hands; inventory what you learned.
59.money: Rock bottom is a floor, not a home; rebuild one brick of routine.
59.health: Rest like recovery, not defeat; the body believes in dawn.

60.name: Page of Swords
60.upright: The watchful student: questions, research, a mind testing the wind. Curiosity with a notebook beats opinion with a megaphone.
60.reversed: The blade is all edge: gossip, cynicism, surveillance dressed as care. Aim the sharp mind at ideas, not people.
60.love: Ask the real question instead of testing them.
60.career: Research first, speak second; your draft improves.
60.money: Investigate before investing; forums are not advisors.
60.health: Dr. Internet says rest first; then verify with a human.

61.name: Knight of Swords
61.upright: Charging with the sword up: fast decisions, direct speech, a debate won at gallop. Aim carefully; at this speed, words land as actions.
61.reversed: All charge, no map: reckless words, arguments for sport, haste scattering the plan. Rein in for one breath before the next sentence.
61.love: Bluntness is not honesty; land the truth with its parachute.
61.career: Move fast on the decision, slow on the announcement.
61.money: Impulse trades and purchases both charge interest.
61.health: Adrenaline is a loan; repay with downshift time.

62.name: Queen of Swords
62.upright: Clear eyes, kind blade: independence earned through experience, counsel that cuts cleanly. Your perception is the gift; deliver it warm.
62.reversed: The wit grows walls: bitterness, cold judgment, honesty as armour. Soften the delivery without dulling the truth.
62.love: Directness is attractive; add one degree of warmth.
62.career: Your review saves projects; phrase the cut as care.
62.money: Sentiment-free review of the numbers, once a month.
62.health: Grief unspoken becomes sharpness; give it words privately.

63.name: King of Swords
63.upright: The judge-king: reason with authority, decisions that hold because they are fair. Think it through, state it once, stand by the standard.
63.reversed: Intellect as armour or lever: cold control, rules bent by cleverness. Fairness includes the cases you dislike.
63.love: Lead with logic, stay for the feeling underneath it.
63.career: Your call sets precedent; document the principle.
63.money: Systems over impulses; let the policy decide at 3 a.m.
63.health: The mind's verdicts are not the body's; listen downstairs too.

64.name: Ace of Pentacles
64.upright: A solid coin in an open hand: a job, offer, or resource with real weight. Plant it properly; this seed likes good soil and patience.
64.reversed: The coin slips or the soil is wrong: missed chance, shaky plan, money promised loosely. Nail the terms before the handshake fades.
64.love: Love with building plans; small reliabilities are romantic.
64.career: A tangible opening; take it and do the paperwork beautifully.
64.money: Seed money rules: start, automate, do not admire it daily.
64.health: One sustainable habit started today outweighs a overhaul.

65.name: Two of Pentacles
65.upright: Two coins, one infinity loop: juggling money, time, and tides with a grin. Keep the rhythm; drop nothing by adding slowly.
65.reversed: A ball bounces away: too much, too uneven, the loop wobbling. Set one coin down on purpose before gravity chooses.
65.love: Make room on the actual calendar; love is also logistics.
65.career: Prioritise in pencil; everything is not a ball, some are stones.
65.money: Cash-flow juggling needs a buffer, not better reflexes.
65.health: Energy is a resource; budget it like money.

66.name: Three of Pentacles
66.upright: Blueprints out, craftspeople talking: skill meeting teamwork, work that will outlast moods. Build with people who respect the plan.
66.reversed: The build site bickers: roles unclear, skill unvalued, plans ignored. Re-draw who does what, in writing, kindly.
66.love: Build something together; shared projects are glue.
66.career: Your craft plus their structure; ask for the brief in writing.
66.money: Collaborative income needs clear splits from day one.
66.health: Train with others; accountability is a structure too.

67.name: Four of Pentacles
67.upright: Coins clutched to chest, head, and feet: security guarded hard, control mistaken for safety. What you own should not own your posture.
67.reversed: The grip softens: generosity, spending on purpose, control released where it was only fear. Open one hand and watch nothing fall.
67.love: Possessiveness is fear in a crown; trust is the braver hold.
67.career: Guard the core, delegate the edges; hoarded work stalls growth.
67.money: Saving is wise; squeezing is different. Fund one joy line.
67.health: Tension is a full-body budget item; unclench deliberately.

68.name: Five of Pentacles
68.upright: Snow outside the warm window: hardship, money worry, feeling left out. The lighted window is the point; help exists and asking is allowed.
68.reversed: The thaw begins: improvement, help accepted, a door opening from inside. Walk toward the warmth without apologising for the cold.
68.love: Hard times are a we-thing; say which part is heaviest.
68.career: Ask for the reference, the intro, the ramp; pride is expensive.
68.money: Hardship maths first: essentials, then one call to negotiate.
68.health: Do not skip care for cost alone; ask what options exist.

69.name: Six of Pentacles
69.upright: Coins weighed and shared: generosity, patronage, fair exchange flowing the right way. Give cleanly or receive cleanly; both are skills.
69.reversed: The scales tilt: strings attached, debt with interest of the soul, giving to control. Rebalance the exchange or decline it kindly.
69.love: Care should circulate, not accumulate as debt.
69.career: Mentorship and fair pay both appear; be the scale, not the thumb.
69.money: Lend what you can gift; gift what you can forget.
69.health: Accept help as maintenance, not defeat.

70.name: Seven of Pentacles
70.upright: Leaning on the hoe, reading the garden: pause, assess, let compounding work. Not every quiet field is failing; some are rooting.
70.reversed: Staring at the plants will not hurry them: impatience, sunk-cost fretting, tending what should be replanted. Review honestly, then commit or compost.
70.love: Long games need small waterings; check what is actually growing.
70.career: Quarterly honesty: keep, fix, or stop; do not just hover.
70.money: Investments need seasons; check the soil, not the hour.
70.health: Fitness compounds quietly; the mirror is a lagging indicator.

71.name: Eight of Pentacles
71.upright: Coin after coin, each better: apprenticeship, repetition, craft compounding. Mastery is a pile of ordinary days done carefully.
71.reversed: The chisel slips: perfectionism, shortcuts, or grind without pride. Return to the standard you respect, one coin at a time.
71.love: Love is also a practice; small repeated kindnesses are the craft.
71.career: Ship the reps; skill is visibly compounding, keep going.
71.money: Earn the raise with documented craft, then ask.
71.health: Technique before intensity; the body loves correct reps.

72.name: Nine of Pentacles
72.upright: In the garden, robed in what she built: abundance earned, self-reliance with good taste. Enjoy it without explaining it.
72.reversed: The garden needs the gardener less weary: overwork, comfort bought at body prices, or a setback to luxuries. Reinvest in rest.
72.love: Whole on your own, generous in company; standards are kind.
72.career: Your track record is the pitch; let it speak first.
72.money: Comfort is funded; keep the boring system that built it.
72.health: Pleasure and rest are part of the portfolio now.

73.name: Ten of Pentacles
73.upright: Three generations under one arch: wealth that means security shared, legacy being built in ordinary kindnesses. Think in decades, act today.
73.reversed: The arch strains: family money friction, inheritance of stress rather than ease. Clarity and kindness, in writing, early.
73.love: Building a household is a long poem; write it together.
73.career: Build the thing that outlasts your role in it.
73.money: Family money talks go better before they are urgent.
73.health: Health is the first inheritance; model it at home.

74.name: Page of Pentacles
74.upright: The student with a coin held like a question: a course, an offer, a practical beginning. Do the homework; this one rewards diligence.
74.reversed: The notebook stays shut: procrastination, plans admired instead of started. Open to page one and do the smallest assignment.
74.love: Show interest in their actual world; reliability is attractive.
74.career: Apply, enrol, submit; the form is the first exam.
74.money: Learn the instrument before buying it; one lesson first.
74.health: Track one metric for two weeks; studentship beats intensity.

75.name: Knight of Pentacles
75.upright: The slowest knight, the surest arrival: method, routine, promises kept in weather. Boring on paper, bankable in life.
75.reversed: The plough will not turn: stubbornness, stagnation, or work eating every other field. Same effort, one new furrow.
75.love: Show up again; steadiness is a love language.
75.career: Your reliability is promotable; make it visible, not just real.
75.money: Automatic beats heroic; raise the transfer by a little.
75.health: Consistency over intensity, every ordinary day.

76.name: Queen of Pentacles
76.upright: The garden-queen: care made tangible, resources made warm, a home that runs on competence and kindness. Nourish, including yourself in the list.
76.reversed: The garden eats the gardener: care as control, work-home blur, self last on the list. Your name goes on the watering rota too.
76.love: Feed people well, then sit down and be fed too.
76.career: Operational kindness scales; systemise the care you give.
76.money: A budget with warmth in it survives contact with life.
76.health: Caregiver, care for the caregiver; book your own check-up.

77.name: King of Pentacles
77.upright: The builder-king among vines and ledgers: prosperity through discipline, success that feeds people. Security is a craft; you practice it daily.
77.reversed: The ledger eats the kingdom: greed, work obsession, providing things instead of presence. Audit what the success is for.
77.love: Provide presence first; the rest is garnish.
77.career: Your systems create safety; teach them, do not hoard them.
77.money: Wealth with a purpose clause outlives wealth with a scoreboard.
77.health: The body is the founding asset; board meetings can wait.
